description:
General Information
New in the Original Packaging – (Unless Bulk Packed)
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Bearing Lock Plate and Bearing Adjuster.
These parts adjust the pressure that is applied to the Front & Rear Differential Bearings
Fits the Front & Rear Differentials
Comes with Installation Bolt!
Genuine Suzuki OEM Parts
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Adjuster, Bearing
Qty 1 – Lock Plate, Bearing
Qty 1 – Bolts, Bearing Lock Plate
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
